title: Learning Management System Incident Response
description: Learning Management System incidents affecting academic operations
triggers: Complete LMS outage affecting academic operations
immediate_actions: Assess impact on academic operations and student learning
Notify Pioneer University IT Operations team
Implement alternative learning procedures if needed
Contact academic departments for course impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review LMS application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to LMS systems
resolution_steps: Restart LMS services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply LMS patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with LMS vendor for complex issues
verification: Test LMS functionality for students and faculty
Confirm with academic staff that system is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Pioneer University IT Operations
special_considerations: During examination periods, LMS and identity incidents are automatically treated as P1
Student learning is critical for academic operations
Coordinate with academic departments for minimal disruption
Document any LMS interruptions that may affect academic schedules
